A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Evaluation date fixed at 1 March 2026 for all rules application.
R1 requires minimum 22 pages exactly satisfying threshold counts valid.
R2 mandates official template OR documented revision history spanning three years minimum together.
R3 prohibits handling Tier-1 venue presentations unless occurring more than 18 months before deadline. Exactly 18 months fails condition. Withdrawal resets venue clock to withdrawal date not actual presentation date for calculation.
R4 blocks prior accepted round if fewer than five years elapsed since that round. Five years exactly passes restriction. Withdrawal never counts as acceptance under this rule regardless of circumstances.
R5 permits paired submission strictly two manuscripts only. Three or more prohibited. Both must independently satisfy R1 and R2 requirements. Only one manuscript needs to satisfy R3 venue constraint neither required both.
R6 exempts Track D from R2 format but requires exactly two endorsements. One endorsement insufficient for validity. Exemption applies only to R2 not retraction or other rules.
R7 blocks handling open retraction notice regardless every other rule including R9 adjustments. Overrides all provisions automatically.
R8 mandates figure count between eight and 45 inclusive standard submissions. Paired submissions allow up to seventy figures minimum eight same lower bound.
R9 pads under eight figures verdict PADDED unless another rule fails submission. Over maximum returns outright regardless of padding status. Fails other rule combined with figure issue verdict RETURNED not PADDED.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":351216492,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
